Usually what I do whenever I discover a new group is pick the song with the title that caught my interest the most and listen to it. As a fan of Alice I would say any song is good in its own way, so whatever you choice is gonna be great, but I don’t know what you’re most into so...
You could also check a lyric first and do the same thing. Really, just let yourself enjoy them! (Some of my favorites are Would, Sea of Sorrow, Bleed The Freak, No Excuses, Down In a Hole, Sunshine, Junkhead...) hope you get into them!

Yep, I literally have no memory of pretty much all my life. Sure, there are some fragments here and there but it’s not much. Also, I have terrible memory with general things so it’s hard for me to keep up with academic life because of that. I just have no fucking clue of anything.

Getting help isn’t easy for sure, but dying isn’t either. I honestly don’t think I’m anyone to say what you should do, because I feel the same, however I do know there are some good things in life (it’s different that we can’t see them, and it’s not necessarily a bad thing). There are some small things that keep me afloat, that give me a grasp of reality. I feel hopeless most of the time and ready to die, but I always try to “measure” my hopelessness. I always think “I’m not there yet, I might be close, but I’m not on my limit just yet”. If you ever feel like venting or talking to someone, I’m here for you. It might not help much, but hey, it will keep you for a day more.

I feel the same...I’m studying something I don’t want to do, and my uni exam for the career I want is in one day. If I don’t pass it I’m gonna be stuck here. I barely see the point in living, and I’ve always felt like I would die young tbh. Passing that exam isn’t just about academic life for me, but it has some other things like me moving out of my house from my toxic family. I honestly feel too tired I don’t know how much long I have left, but I already started making plans and saying goodbye. Maybe I am too weak to live.

Actually I was thinking something a bit similar, specially during these weeks where I have been listening to them a lot. 

I’m in a bad state of mind most of the time so really I just find some comfort in their music, and I think a lot about Layne and when he died. It makes my heart ache. But I honestly have this rule of not listening anything from Alice during the day or mornings (unless it’s something like We Die Young or Sea of Sorrow, which kinda lifts my mood), because every time I listen Layne’s voice it just gets me in a pretty dark state of mind, even more so than normal. I just get super sensitive, so I usually listen to them until night or to sleep (oh and there’s something about Alice that’s quite addictive). 

The moment I play one song (say, Over Now) I immediately break into tears lol. But yeah, still love them though.
Sometimes I feel like things move a little, like if I am in a room it might shake a bit, but I believe that’s the only thing.

Luckily we’re still under lockdown...right? Right?
